function: AES S-box (c = 0) or inverse S-box (c = 1), NIST aes-sbox-sel (FIPS 197)
method_description: gate kernel: care-set gate replacement moves with annealing, under caps on (A, AD, GD)
chain_root: our published forward circuit aes-sbox-a28-ad4-g135-gd18-xx107-55 (its own logs give its lineage)
lineage: gate kernel polish (cli.py run --target aes-sbox-sel): this circuit
found_utc_source: the run's improvement event for this circuit (events.jsonl.gz), from the run's start time

first_find.evidence: scan.py of every circuit file in the run folders of these runs and the published circuits: the earliest circuit with this (A, AD, G, GD)

campaign.what: S-box with a direction bit from one forward circuit (ops/selbuild.py: input and output affine maps switched by c around the shared circuit), then kernel polishes of the builds (cli.py run --target aes-sbox-sel)

code.run_tree: the idea checkout on 08012e1 with uncommitted changes (targets.py aes-sbox-sel target, untracked ops/selbuild.py; code.diff.gz)
code.note: the run's sources_sha256 (58d6f9ef...) equals b8ba66e's package: the code that ran was committed unchanged as b8ba66e; the direction-select builds it started from were made by ops/selbuild.py (lineage)

diff.what: the run's recorded git diff of its checkout against 08012e1 (tracked changes and untracked files)

reproducibility.text: one-off: a time-budgeted run (not bit-reproducible); not re-run. The exact command, seed, code and the run's own logs for this circuit are here

command: python3 search/nonlinear/boolflux/cli.py run --target aes-sbox-sel --model nist --start <campaign archive>/2026-11-17-ideas/02/A/aes-sbox-a28-ad4-g135-gd18-xx107-55-xdelta-leafg/aes-sbox-sel-a36-ad6-g235-gd24-xx199-59.circ.txt --objective a,ad,cost,gd --cap-a 36 --cap-ad 6 --cap-gd 24 --iters 100000000 --seconds 360 --seeds 1 --jobs 1 --out <campaign archive>/2026-11-17-ideas/02/B/b7-gd24
